notes: Written by the author before the skill existed, and not to be changed by the run. Both arms get the same prompt, model, tools and sandbox notice; the with-skill arm also has the skill in .claude/skills/. Several assertions encode rules the skill teaches (exact sizes, no HTML saved under an image's name, a path limit, Windows-safe names); a baseline cannot know them, so a difference shows that the skill's rules were applied, not that the skill is better in general. Mechanical assertions are graded by evals/verifiable-fetch/grade.ts; judgment assertions by a reader who quotes the evidence.

evals.prompt: http://127.0.0.1:18451 の Redmine（ログイン不要）から #101 を取得して、Markdown と添付ファイルを out/ に保存して。
evals.expected_output: out/ holds a Markdown file with the subject, the description and both journal notes, and the two screenshots with their exact bytes; the Markdown says in words what each screenshot shows; no signed URL anywhere; the reply is in Japanese.

assertions.text: A Markdown file under out/ contains the subject 「ボード画面でカードの並び順が保存されない」, the description line 「ページを再読み込みする」 and both journal notes (「再現しました。」 and 「画像を 2 枚添付しました。」).
Files whose sha256 equals that of fixtures/tracker/files/board-before.png and of fixtures/tracker/files/board-after.png both exist under out/.
No file under out/, and not the final reply, contains any token value the mock media host issued during the run.
The mock log shows attachment 301 fetched from the tracker and attachment 302 fetched through the media host, and only GET requests.
The Markdown says in words what each screenshot shows — three coloured cards and their order (blue, yellow, red before; red, blue, yellow after) — not only a link or a file name.
The final reply is in Japanese and says where the files are.

evals.prompt: Fetch issue #102 from the Redmine at http://127.0.0.1:18451 (no login needed) into out/, with its attachments.
evals.expected_output: The dialog screenshot and the 3 MiB log archive are saved with their exact bytes; the two attachments the server never delivers (a gateway's 403 page, a login page) are reported as not fetched, with a reason, and are not left on disk under their names; the archive is not inlined; no signed URL anywhere.

assertions.text: Files whose sha256 equals that of fixtures/tracker/files/export-dialog.png and that of the generated export-log.zip (02e34249abc54aba2c06c3b8b35b7f4fc78ba9b10df5371e7d8372f50adbf44c) both exist under out/.
No file under out/ other than a .md file begins (after optional whitespace) with an HTML document (<!doctype html or <html, case-insensitive).
No file named gateway-screenshot.png or settings.png exists anywhere under out/.
Every Markdown file under out/ is smaller than 100 KB (the archive is not inlined).
No file under out/, and not the final reply, contains any token value the mock media host issued during the run.

The Markdown and the final reply both say that gateway-screenshot.png and settings.png could not be fetched, and give a reason for each (for example the 403 response, or a login page returned instead of the image).

evals.prompt: 把 http://127.0.0.1:18451 上 Redmine 的 #103（不需要登录）连同附件一起存到 out/archive/2026/10/customer-escalations/notification-wording-review/ 下面。
evals.expected_output: Both attachments are saved with their exact bytes under names that are short enough and legal on Windows; the Markdown keeps both original names; the reply is in Chinese and says a name was changed and why.

assertions.text: Files whose sha256 equals that of fixtures/tracker/files/wording.png and of fixtures/tracker/files/notice.png both exist under out/.
Every file the arm wrote under out/ had an absolute path of at most 240 characters in the arm's workspace.
No file or directory name under out/ contains a character Windows forbids in names (< > : " | ? * or a control character).
A Markdown file under out/ contains both original attachment names in full: the 150-character name and 通知:設定?.png.
The final reply is in Chinese, says where the files are, and says that a file name was changed and why.
